comment: PT Part 8: Techniques (adapted from the user's Arcanist Axiomatic Techniques). Picks at levels 2, 3, 6, 10, 14 and 18 (data/leveling.json techniqueLevels) from a shared pool; minLevel by tier. Every class can take any category; classes lean (data/classes.json techniqueLean). Reconfigure at the night workbench (1 AP) or an arena checkpoint (1 Arena AP). 'planned' ones are listed but not active yet (they need potions, constructs acting or once-per-night systems).

techniques.name: Runic Toolkit
techniques.text: Learn the Construct Form. Your Constructs have +50% HP.

techniques.name: Modular Imbuement
techniques.text: Weapon Infusion can store a Glyph: your next Strike places it.

techniques.name: Efficient Forging
techniques.text: Constructs and Glyphs cost 1 less MP.

techniques.name: Lasting Rune
techniques.text: Constructs and Glyphs last 2 rounds longer.

techniques.name: Overcharged Construct
techniques.text: Your Constructs pulse their Vector each round.

techniques.name: Living Foundry
techniques.text: Once per fight, a Construct acts as an ally for 3 rounds.

techniques.name: Stored Formula
techniques.text: Once per night, brew a spell card into a one-use Potion any party member can play as a Quick.

techniques.name: Reactive Terrain
techniques.text: Once per fight, saturate a 3x3 area with your Vector for 3 rounds.

techniques.name: Volatile Brewing
techniques.text: Potions come out one Magnitude higher, with a 1-in-6 Instability chance.

techniques.name: Damage Type Fluency
techniques.text: Once per turn, change a card's Vector to another you know.

techniques.name: Grand Reagent
techniques.text: Once per week, brew a Grand potion early.

techniques.name: Mutation Mastery
techniques.text: Choose the volatile outcome instead of rolling it.

techniques.name: Vector Redirection
techniques.text: Reaction, 2 MP: an attack aimed only at you is redirected to another enemy within 3 of you.

techniques.name: Reactive Casting
techniques.text: Once per round, cast your Cantrip at an enemy that steps next to you.

techniques.name: Conversion Reflex
techniques.text: Reaction, 1 MP: damage of a Vector you know is reduced by INT/2 + level/2.

techniques.name: Mid-Flight Correction
techniques.text: Your Projectiles and Lines ignore half cover.

techniques.name: Perfect Counter
techniques.text: Vector Redirection costs 0 MP.

techniques.name: Living Equation
techniques.text: Your Quick Strike can be your Cantrip instead (a Quick).

techniques.name: Still Mind
techniques.text: Your first Instability roll each fight rolls twice and keeps the best.

techniques.name: Meditative Reserve
techniques.text: Rest rooms and arena checkpoints restore +3 MP.

techniques.name: Resilient Mind
techniques.text: All Instability rolls roll twice and keep the best.

techniques.name: Internal Casting
techniques.text: Hazards don't hurt you on your own turn while you have at least 1 MP.

techniques.name: Deep Calculation
techniques.text: Once per night, restore full MP as an Action.

techniques.name: One With the Formula
techniques.text: Instability thresholds +3.

reactions.comment: Reactions (Redirection, Conversion Reflex): Options 'reactions' = auto (default), ask (acts like auto until the prompt exists), never.
